name: Rackpad
description: Rackpad is a self-hosted inventory and operations tool for homelabs and small datacenters, tracking racks, devices, ports, cables, IPAM, VLANs, and Wi-Fi. It also provides network discovery, monitoring, reporting, and rack/cable topology visualization.

ports.name: SNMP Trap Port
ports.description: SNMP trap receiver, enabled by default upstream. Only needed if you use SNMP trap monitoring.

variables.name: Trust Proxy
variables.description: Set to 1 when Rackpad sits behind a reverse proxy (Nginx, Caddy, Traefik, etc).

variables.name: Trusted Hosts
variables.description: Comma-separated hostnames Rackpad should accept in production, e.g. rackpad.example.com.

variables.name: Trusted Origins
variables.description: Comma-separated browser origins Rackpad should trust in production, e.g. https://rackpad.example.com.

variables.name: App URL
variables.description: Public origin Rackpad is reached at. Required when using OIDC login or a reverse proxy.

variables.name: Monitor Interval
variables.description: Background health-check loop interval in milliseconds.

variables.name: Secret Key
variables.description: Long random value (e.g. openssl rand -hex 32) required before storing shared SNMP credential secrets. ICMP/TCP/HTTP monitoring works without it.
